question: Should this production Supabase patch update require a repository-run auth/query/realtime smoke result, or is the current CI matrix plus preview deployment an acceptable proof override?
rationale: The branch is now narrowly scoped, but Dependabot cannot provide application-specific runtime evidence and the appropriate evidence threshold for this repository is a maintainer-owned release-risk choice.

options.title: Run a focused Supabase smoke check
options.body: Capture a redacted successful application auth, query, or realtime flow on the current head before merging.

options.title: Accept CI and preview evidence
options.body: Merge after all required checks finish if the repository owner accepts that the existing matrix and deployed preview sufficiently cover this patch update.

recommendation.title: Run a focused Supabase smoke check
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted successful application auth, query, or realtime flow on the current head before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current scope-correction commit and are the clearest available owner for accepting or supplying repository-specific runtime evidence.
